engine.name: Stockfish 17.1
engine.notes: Puzzle solutions at depth 16. Mate puzzles are forced mates in 1–4 with a complete line to checkmate, unique at each of the player's moves (MultiPV 2). Non-mate puzzles stop when the material gain is on the board (max 5 plies), and each of his moves in the line is the only clearly-best move (gap ≥ 150cp). Evals and PVs are engine output only.
